edits.original: Researchers divide carbon-concentrating mechanisms into a spatial regime, where mesophyll and bundle-sheath cells share the work, and a temporal regime, where stomata open at night, close to the C4-versus-CAM split, spatial packing is the C4 case, temporal packing is the CAM one.
edits.replacement: Researchers divide carbon-concentrating mechanisms into a spatial regime, where mesophyll and bundle-sheath cells share the work (C4 case), and a temporal regime, where stomata open at night (CAM case).
edits.reason: Definition doubling: the second half merely restates the C4/CAM split with no new information, so it can be condensed into parentheses.

edits.original: Morphine is not synthesized by the Pacific yew; it is produced in Papaver somniferum latex.
edits.replacement: Morphine is produced in Papaver somniferum latex.
edits.reason: Padded negation: deleting the negative clause leaves the positive claim intact without losing information.
